_说明: 核心句型 S001-S050。字段: id/title/formula(en,cn,note)。AI整理初版待人工校对。

items.title: 主系表
items.formula: 主语 + be/系动词 + 表语
items.en: He is a doctor. / The flowers look beautiful.
items.cn: 他是医生。／这些花看起来很美。
items.note: 系动词: be, look, seem, feel, sound, taste, smell, become, get, turn, grow, keep, stay

items.title: 主谓
items.formula: 主语 + 不及物动词
items.en: The sun rises in the east.
items.cn: 太阳从东方升起。
items.note: 不及物动词后不可直接接宾语

items.title: 主谓宾
items.formula: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语
items.en: She is reading an English book.
items.cn: 她正在读一本英语书。

items.title: 主谓双宾
items.formula: 主语 + 及物动词 + 间接宾语 + 直接宾语
items.en: My father bought me a new bike.
items.cn: 爸爸给我买了一辆新自行车。
items.note: buy/give/pass/send/show/tell/teach 等;也可改 for/to sb

items.title: 主谓宾宾补
items.formula: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
items.en: We keep our classroom clean.
items.cn: 我们保持教室干净。
items.note: make/keep/find/see/watch/hear/let/have 等

items.title: There be 存在句
items.formula: There + be + 名词 + 地点/时间
items.en: There is a computer on the desk.
items.cn: 桌上有一台电脑。
items.note: 就近原则; 可接 be going to/happens to/must be 等

items.title: 一般现在时
items.formula: 主语 + do/does + 其他
items.en: I go to school by bus every day.
items.cn: 我每天坐公交车上学。
items.note: 表经常性/习惯性/客观真理

items.title: 现在进行时
items.formula: 主语 + am/is/are + doing
items.en: Look! The children are playing football.
items.cn: 看！孩子们正在踢足球。
items.note: 表正在进行或现阶段

items.title: 现在完成时
items.formula: 主语 + have/has + done
items.en: I have finished my homework already.
items.cn: 我已经完成作业了。
items.note: already/yet/just/ever/never/since/for

items.title: 一般过去时
items.formula: 主语 + did + 其他
items.en: We visited the museum yesterday.
items.cn: 我们昨天参观了博物馆。
items.note: yesterday/ago/last night/in 2020

items.title: 一般将来时
items.formula: 主语 + will/be going to + do
items.en: It will rain tomorrow. / We are going to have a picnic.
items.cn: 明天会下雨。／我们打算去野餐。
items.note: will 表临时决定; be going to 表计划

items.title: It is + adj + to do
items.formula: It is + 形容词 + to do sth
items.en: It is important to learn English well.
items.cn: 学好英语很重要。
items.note: It is + adj + for/of sb + to do; dangerous/necessary/possible/useful

items.title: It is + adj + that 从句
items.formula: It is + 形容词 + that 从句
items.en: It is certain that he will pass the exam.
items.cn: 他一定会通过考试。
items.note: certain/clear/true/wonderful/strange/necessary

items.title: It is + n + that/to do
items.formula: It is + 名词 + that 从句 / to do
items.en: It is a good idea to go swimming. / It is a pity that you missed it.
items.cn: 去游泳是个好主意。／你错过了真可惜。
items.note: pity/shame/pleasure/honor/idea

items.title: It takes sb time to do
items.formula: It takes/took sb + 时间 + to do sth
items.en: It took me two hours to finish the work.
items.cn: 我花了两个小时完成这项工作。
items.note: spend/cost 句型见 S016-S017

items.title: sb spend time doing/on
items.formula: sb + spend 时间/金钱 + (in) doing sth / on sth
items.en: He spends two hours (in) reading every day.
items.cn: 他每天花两小时读书。
items.note: pay/cost 表花费见 S017

items.title: sth cost / sb pay
items.formula: sth cost(s) sb 钱 / sb pay(s) 钱 for sth
items.en: The book cost me 30 yuan. / I paid 30 yuan for the book.
items.cn: 这本书花了我三十元。／我花了三十元买这本书。

items.title: too...to...
items.formula: 主语 + be + too + 形容词/副词 + to do
items.en: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
items.cn: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。
items.note: 表否定结果; too ready/anxious/eager to 表肯定

items.title: ...enough to...
items.formula: 主语 + be + 形容词 + enough + (for sb) to do
items.en: He is old enough to go to school.
items.cn: 他到了上学的年龄了。
items.note: enough 放形容词/副词后

items.title: so...that...
items.formula: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句
items.en: The problem is so difficult that nobody can work it out.
items.cn: 这个问题太难了，没人能解出来。
items.note: so...that 可换 such...that/too...to

items.title: such...that...
items.formula: such + (a/an)+形容词+名词 + that 从句
items.en: It is such an interesting film that we all like it.
items.cn: 这是一部如此有趣的电影，我们都喜欢。
items.note: such...that 与 so...that 互换规则

items.title: as...as 同级比较
items.formula: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as ... / not as(so)...as
items.en: Tom is as tall as Jack. / He does not run so fast as me.
items.cn: 汤姆和杰克一样高。／他跑得不如我快。
items.note: 倍数+as...as 见 S027

items.title: 比较级+than
items.formula: A + be/实义动词 + 比较级 + than B
items.en: This picture is more beautiful than that one.
items.cn: 这幅画比那幅更美。
items.note: much/even/a little/far 修饰比较级

items.title: the+比较级, the+比较级
items.formula: The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...
items.en: The more you read, the more you learn.
items.cn: 你读得越多，学得越多。
items.note: 越……就越……

items.title: 比较级 and 比较级
items.formula: 比较级 + and + 比较级
items.en: Our country is becoming stronger and stronger.
items.cn: 我们的国家变得越来越强大。
items.note: 多音节: more and more beautiful

items.title: 最高级
items.formula: the + 最高级 + in/of/among ...
items.en: He is the tallest student in our class.
items.cn: 他是我们班最高的学生。
items.note: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词

items.title: 倍数表达
items.formula: A is 倍数 + as...as B / 倍数+比较级+than B
items.en: This room is twice as large as that one.
items.cn: 这个房间是那个的两倍大。
items.note: twice/three times 等

items.title: not...until...
items.formula: not...until 直到……才……
items.en: He did not go to bed until his mother came back.
items.cn: 直到妈妈回来他才上床睡觉。
items.note: 倒装句 Not until 从句 did+主语 见语法点

items.title: hardly...when / no sooner...than
items.formula: hardly + 过去完成 + when ... / no sooner + 过去完成 + than ...
items.en: Hardly had I got home when it began to rain.
items.cn: 我刚到家就开始下雨了。
items.note: 一……就……; 前句需倒装

items.title: as soon as 一……就……
items.formula: As soon as + 从句, 主句
items.en: As soon as he arrived, we started the meeting.
items.cn: 他一到，我们就开会了。
items.note: 可换 the moment/immediately/instantly

items.title: be about to do...when...
items.formula: sb + be about to do + when 从句(突然)
items.en: I was about to leave when the telephone rang.
items.cn: 我正要离开，电话铃响了。
items.note: when 前常用过去进行/be about to

items.title: be doing...when...
items.formula: sb + be doing + when 从句(突然)
items.en: We were watching TV when the light went out.
items.cn: 我们正在看电视，突然灯灭了。

items.title: had better do
items.formula: sb + had better (not) do sth
items.en: You had better go to bed early.
items.cn: 你最好早点睡。
items.note: 后接动词原形

items.title: would rather do than do
items.formula: would rather do A than do B
items.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
items.cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿出去。
items.note: prefer to do rather than do 同义

items.title: prefer doing to doing
items.formula: prefer A to B / prefer doing A to doing B
items.en: She prefers singing to dancing.
items.cn: 她宁愿唱歌而不愿跳舞。

items.title: used to do
items.formula: sb used to do sth (过去常常)
items.en: I used to get up late.
items.cn: 我过去常常晚起。
items.note: 否定 didn't use to / used not to; 与 be used to doing 区分

items.title: be used to doing
items.formula: sb + be/get used to + doing sth (习惯)
items.en: He is used to living in the countryside.
items.cn: 他习惯住在乡下。
items.note: to 后接名词/动名词

items.title: be worth doing
items.formula: sth + be worth + doing
items.en: The book is well worth reading.
items.cn: 这本书很值得一读。
items.note: 值得做; worthy of / It is worthwhile to do

items.title: be busy doing
items.formula: sb + be busy doing sth / be busy with sth
items.en: The students are busy preparing for the exam.
items.cn: 学生们正忙着备考。

items.title: keep/stop/prevent sb from doing
items.formula: keep/stop/prevent sb from doing sth
items.en: The rain prevented us from going out.
items.cn: 雨使我们无法外出。
items.note: stop/prevent 可省 from 后接动名词? 通常保留

items.title: make sb do
items.formula: make/let/have sb do sth
items.en: The teacher made us read the text aloud.
items.cn: 老师让我们大声朗读课文。
items.note: 被动: be made to do; 感官动词见 S042

items.title: see/watch/hear sb do/doing
items.formula: see/watch/hear/notice sb do sth 或 doing sth
items.en: I saw him cross the street. / I saw him crossing the street.
items.cn: 我看见他过了街。／我看见他正在过街。
items.note: do 表全过程, doing 表正在进行; 被动 to do

items.title: have sth done
items.formula: have/get sth done
items.en: I had my bike repaired yesterday.
items.cn: 我昨天请人修了自行车。
items.note: 表请人做/遭遇; have sb do; have sth doing

items.title: get sb to do
items.formula: get sb to do sth / get sth doing
items.en: He got his friend to help him.
items.cn: 他让朋友帮他。
items.note: get 后宾补用 to do, have/make 用 do

items.title: It is said/reported that...
items.formula: It is said/reported/believed that 从句
items.en: It is said that he has gone abroad.
items.cn: 据说他出国了。
items.note: 可换 sb is said to do/have done

items.title: sb be said to do
items.formula: sb + be said/reported/believed + to do / to have done
items.en: He is said to be a famous writer.
items.cn: 据说他是一位著名作家。
items.note: 表据说/据报道

items.title: There is no doubt that...
items.formula: There is no doubt that 从句
items.en: There is no doubt that he will win.
items.cn: 毫无疑问他会赢。
items.note: There is no need to do; There is no point doing

items.title: It is (high) time that...
items.formula: It is (high) time that sb did/should do sth
items.en: It is time that we went to bed.
items.cn: 我们该睡觉了。
items.note: 从句用过去时或 should do(虚拟)

items.title: It occurs to sb that...
items.formula: It occurs/occurred to sb that 从句
items.en: It occurred to me that I had left my keys at home.
items.cn: 我突然想起把钥匙落在家里了。
items.note: 某人突然想到

items.title: What if...
items.formula: What if + 句子?
items.en: What if it rains tomorrow?
items.cn: 明天下雨怎么办？
items.note: How about/What about + n/doing
